tests.title: The reviser's submission is accepted for the four dispositions and turned back for anything else
given: a round with three findings and a reviser submission that varies only in its answers
tests.when: the submission answers them in turn with each of fixed, contested, escalated and declined; with a fifth word; with one finding answered twice; with one finding not answered; and with an answer whose id is not of this round
then: each of the four dispositions is accepted and recorded against its finding
a fifth word is turned back with one error naming the offending id and the four values
the duplicate, the missing and the unknown id are each turned back with one error naming every offending id
every turned-back submission records nothing: no revised PRD and no answer is kept
tests.pseudocode: table in specgen/revision_tool_test.go, extending the checkDispositions cases: tool = newRevisionTool(sink, current, findings, ws); res = tool.Execute(ctx, case.args); assert res.IsError == case.refused; assert res.Content names each id in case.names; assert sink.get() reports nothing done for a refused case

tests.title: A revision that answers a finding fixed and changes nothing is turned back
given: a round with two findings and the PRD as the review saw it
tests.when: the submission answers one finding fixed while the body, open questions, relevant files and notes are the PRD's as it was; and then when it answers both contested with counter-evidence and changes nothing
then: the first submission is turned back, the error saying that answering a finding fixed means changing the PRD to remedy it
the second submission is accepted: a revision that answers no finding fixed may leave the PRD as it was
nothing is recorded for the refused submission
tests.pseudocode: in specgen/revision_tool_test.go, beside the unchanged_prd case: submit with the body of current and one fixed answer; assert the error mentions remedying; submit again with every answer contested and valid counter-evidence; assert accepted

tests.title: A contest is accepted only with counter-evidence the run can find
given: a PRD and an input with known sentences in them, and a repository with a known file and a known directory
a round with one finding
tests.when: the finding is contested in turn with a quote from the PRD, a quote from the input, the same quote with its whitespace laid out differently, a quote that is in neither, the path of the file, the path of the directory, a path that does not exist, a path that resolves outside the repository, and with no counter-evidence at all
then: the quotes found in the PRD or the input are accepted, the differently spaced one among them
the existing file path and the existing directory path are accepted
the quote in neither, the path that does not exist, the path outside the repository and the empty counter-evidence are each turned back
each refusal names the finding's id and says whether the quote was not found or the path does not exist
tests.pseudocode: table in specgen/revision_tool_test.go: ws = workspace over a temp repository holding the known file and directory; for each case — submit one contested answer with case.evidence; assert res.IsError == case.refused and that the message names the id and case.says

tests.title: A decline needs a reason, and a critical or steering finding cannot be declined at all
given: a round holding one minor finding with the prd rubric, one critical finding, and one major finding with the steering rubric
tests.when: the minor finding is declined without a reason; then with a reason; then the critical finding is declined with a reason; then the steering finding is declined with a reason
then: the decline without a reason is turned back, the error naming the id and saying a decline must give its scope reason or name the later package
the minor finding declined with a reason is accepted
the critical finding declined is turned back, the error naming the id with its severity
the steering finding declined is turned back, the error naming the id with its rubric
each error says such a finding is fixed, contested or escalated, and nothing is recorded
tests.pseudocode: table in specgen/revision_tool_test.go: for each case — submit the answers; assert res.IsError == case.refused; assert the message names case.id and case.says

tests.title: A reviser cannot change a finding's severity or its rubric
given: a round with one major finding whose rubric is steering
tests.when: the submission answers it fixed and also carries a severity of minor and a rubric of prd in the arguments of that answer
then: the submission is accepted, the extra fields being ignored rather than refused
the recorded finding still has the severity major and the rubric steering the review phase gave it
the same holds when the submission carries only one of the two
tests.pseudocode: in specgen/revision_tool_test.go: submit raw JSON with severity and rubric inside the disposition object; assert accepted; after answer() runs, assert findings[0].Severity == "major" and findings[0].Rubric == "steering"

tests.title: An escalation needs its question, its two or three options, its decision and its reason
given: a round with one major finding and a revised body that holds the decision text
tests.when: the finding is escalated in turn with every field present and two options, with three options, with one option, with four options, with no options, and with each of the question, the decision and the reason missing
then: two options and three options are accepted
one, four and none are turned back, the error saying an escalation carries two or three options each in one sentence
each missing field is turned back, the error naming the id and the fields missing
nothing is recorded for a refused submission
tests.pseudocode: table in specgen/revision_tool_test.go: for each case — submit one escalated answer built from case; assert res.IsError == case.refused; assert the message names the id and each missing field

tests.title: An escalation's decision must appear in the revised body
given: a round with one major finding and an escalation whose decision is a known sentence
tests.when: the submission carries a body that holds that sentence; then one that holds it with its whitespace laid out differently; then one that does not hold it at all
then: the body holding the sentence is accepted
the body holding it with different whitespace is accepted
the body without it is turned back, the error naming the id and saying the decision belongs under the PRD's Design Decisions section opening with the word Provisional
nothing is recorded for the refused submission
tests.pseudocode: in specgen/revision_tool_test.go, beside the counter-evidence cases, using the same whitespace normalisation sameEvidence applies: submit each body; assert res.IsError == case.refused and the message for the refusal

tests.title: A contested finding may be reopened with new evidence; a declined or escalated one may not be raised again
given: the findings of round 1, one answered fixed, one contested, one declined, one escalated and one unanswered, each with a known section, flaw and evidence
tests.when: round 2's review submits in turn: a repeat of the contested finding with no reopens id; a reopen of it with the evidence the contest answered; a reopen of it with new evidence; a repeat of the declined finding with and without a reopens id; a repeat of the escalated finding; a reopens id naming the fixed finding; one naming the unanswered finding; one naming no finding of this PRD; a reopens id in round 1; and a new finding on the flaw an earlier round fixed, with no reopens id
then: the reopen of the contested finding with new evidence is accepted and recorded with that reopens id
the repeat with no reopens id and the reopen with the answered evidence are turned back, each error naming the earlier finding's id
both repeats of the declined finding and the repeat of the escalated one are turned back, each error naming the earlier id and its disposition
a reopens id naming a fixed, an unanswered or an unknown finding, and any reopens id in round 1, are each turned back with one error naming the id and what is wrong
the new finding on the fixed flaw, raised with no reopens id, is accepted
tests.pseudocode: table in specgen/review_tool_test.go, extending the checkFinding reopen cases: tool = newReviewTool(sink, 2, earlier); res = tool.Execute(ctx, case.args); assert res.IsError == case.refused; assert the message names case.names; assert sink records nothing for a refusal

tests.title: Every finding carries a rubric of prd or steering, and nothing else
given: a steering body holding a known directive, and a review that raises three findings
tests.when: the findings are submitted with the rubrics prd, steering quoting that directive, and a third word
then: the prd finding is accepted and recorded with the rubric prd
the steering finding quoting the directive is accepted and recorded with the rubric steering
the third word is turned back with one error naming the position and the two values
a finding submitted with an empty rubric is turned back the same way
tests.pseudocode: in specgen/review_tool_test.go: tool = newReviewTool(sink, 1, nil, steeringBody); submit the three findings; assert the accepted ones' Rubric; submit the bad rubric and assert the error names "prd" and "steering"

tests.title: A steering finding must quote the directive and must not be minor
given: a steering body holding a known directive
tests.when: a steering finding is submitted in turn with evidence quoting that directive, with the quote spaced differently, with evidence quoting nothing from the steering, with the severity critical, with major, and with minor
then: the quote and the differently spaced quote are accepted
evidence quoting nothing from the steering is turned back, the error naming the position and saying the evidence must quote the directive it contradicts
critical and major are accepted
minor is turned back, the error naming the position and saying a steering finding is critical or major
nothing is recorded for a refused submission
tests.pseudocode: table in specgen/review_tool_test.go: for each case — submit one steering finding built from case; assert res.IsError == case.refused and the message names case.says

tests.title: A later round is handed every earlier finding with the fields its answer carries
given: five earlier findings, one answered fixed, one contested, one escalated, one declined and one unanswered, every field filled with a distinctive value
tests.when: the block of earlier rounds is built for the reviewer and for the reviser
then: every finding's id, severity, rubric, section, flaw, evidence, remedy and any reopens id appears
the contested one shows its reason and its counter-evidence
the escalated one shows its question, every option, its decision and its reason
the declined one shows its reason, and the unanswered one shows none of the answer fields
the reviewer's block says a contested finding may be reopened only with evidence the contest did not answer, and that a declined or escalated one may not be raised again
tests.pseudocode: in specgen/prompts_test.go, beside the earlierRoundsBlock cases: got = earlierRoundsBlock(findings, forReviewer); assert every distinctive value of each finding is in got, and that the unanswered finding's block holds none of the answer labels

tests.title: A round with only minor findings is clean and still revised; one with no findings is clean and not revised
given: a round limit of 3 and a scripted reviewer and reviser
tests.when: the review of a round raises in turn one major finding, one minor finding, and no finding at all
then: the major round is recorded as not clean
the minor round is recorded clean and its revision ran, every minor finding carrying an answer
the round with no findings is recorded clean and no revision phase was started for it
the rounds do not stop at a clean round unless the round before it was clean or the limit is reached
tests.pseudocode: table in specgen/rounds_test.go, beside TestRunRounds_StopForTheRightReason: script the reviewer per round; _, rev, err = e.runRounds(ctx, prd, "", nil); assert rev.Rounds[i].Clean == case.clean; assert the count of revision calls the script saw

tests.title: The rounds stop as converged on two consecutive clean rounds and as exhausted otherwise
given: a scripted reviewer whose findings per round the test chooses, and round limits of 1, 2, 3 and 5
tests.when: the sequence of rounds is in turn: clean then clean; clean then major then clean then clean; major every round to the limit; clean then major then clean with a limit of 3; and one round at a limit of 1, clean and not clean
then: clean then clean stops as converged at round 2, and no third round is started even where the limit allows one
clean, major, clean, clean stops as converged at round 4
major every round stops as rounds_exhausted with the rounds run equal to the limit
clean, major, clean at a limit of 3 stops as rounds_exhausted, the two clean rounds not being consecutive
a limit of 1 stops as rounds_exhausted whether the round was clean or not, and never as converged
tests.pseudocode: table in specgen/rounds_test.go: for each case — script the reviewer's findings per round; _, rev, _ = e.runRounds(...); assert rev.StopReason == case.want and rev.RoundsRun == case.rounds

tests.title: A phase that does not finish stops the rounds as incomplete and leaves its findings unanswered
given: a round limit of 3 and a scripted reviewer and reviser that can be made to fail
tests.when: the review of round 1 fails; the revision of round 1 fails; round 1 is clean, round 2's review is clean and round 2's revision then fails, so the rounds would have converged had it finished; and the total budget is spent before round 2's review
then: every case stops the rounds with the stop reason incomplete, the would-have-converged case included, so incomplete wins over converged
the findings of a round whose revision did not finish all carry the disposition unanswered and none of the answer fields
the findings of the rounds before it keep the answers they had
one high warning names the scope, the round, the phase that failed and why, and the run's exit code is unchanged
the PRD returned is the last complete one
tests.pseudocode: table in specgen/rounds_test.go, extending TestRunRounds_AFailedPhaseStopsTheRoundsWithAWarning and TestRunRounds_AFailedRevisionLeavesItsFindingsUnanswered: for each case — make the scripted phase fail; assert rev.StopReason == "incomplete"; assert the dispositions; assert the warning's severity and text

tests.title: The record carries clean per round, a rubric and an answer per finding, and six totals derived from the rounds
given: three rounds whose findings between them use all five dispositions, both rubrics and all three severities
tests.when: the record is built from those rounds
then: each round carries whether it was clean, true exactly for the rounds with no critical and no major finding
each finding carries a rubric of prd or steering

a fixed finding carries its disposition alone, a contested one its reason and counter-evidence, an escalated one its question, options, decision and reason, a declined one its reason, and an unanswered one none of them
the findings count equals the number of findings over every round and equals the sum of the fixed, contested, escalated, declined and unanswered counts
tests.pseudocode: in specgen/rounds_test.go, replacing TestBuildReview_TotalsAgreeWithTheRounds: rev = buildReview(rounds, limit, stop); assert rev.Rounds[i].Clean; assert each finding's fields by its disposition; assert rev.FindingsCount == sum of the five counts and == total findings

tests.title: The record's stop reason is one of three, and none of the replaced vocabulary is encoded
given: a result carrying a review of two rounds with every disposition and every stop reason in turn
tests.when: the result is encoded as JSON, in the full view and in the summary view
then: the stop reason is one of converged, rounds_exhausted and incomplete, for every path including a review with no round started
the encoded JSON holds none of the strings accepted, rejected, accepted_count, rejected_count, no_findings or no_serious_findings
the summary view keeps the six counts and the stop reason and drops the rounds, as it does today
tests.pseudocode: table in envelope/spec_result_test.go: b = json.Marshal(result); for each replaced token assert !bytes.Contains(b, token); assert the stop reason is in the set of three; then marshal the summary view and assert the counts survive and rounds is absent

tests.title: Every escalation reaches the written package's open questions, in order and without duplicates
given: a pipeline run over a scripted model whose rounds escalate two findings in round 1 and one in round 2, one of them repeating a question the PRD phase already recorded
tests.when: the rounds stop and the package is built, once where round 2's revision replaces the open questions wholesale and once where it leaves them alone
then: the package's open questions hold one entry per escalation, carrying the question, the decision and the reason, in round order and then in the order the reviser answered them
the escalation whose question already appeared is not added twice
the escalations of round 1 are present even where round 2's revision replaced the open questions
the run's open-question count includes them
tests.pseudocode: in specgen/pipeline_test.go, beside the open-questions cases: run the pipeline with the scripted reviewer and reviser; assert got.OpenQuestions equals the expected list in order; assert the count in the summary

tests.title: The summary clause names the rounds, the findings with the steering ones apart, and the number fixed
given: results carrying a review of a single package and of a split, with and without a steering finding
tests.when: the summary sentence is built for each
then: a review of two rounds with nine findings of which one is steering and seven fixed reads: review: 2 rounds, 9 findings (1 steering), 7 fixed
a review with no steering finding leaves the parenthesis out
a review with no finding names the rounds and the findings and no fixed count
a split counts the rounds, findings and fixed of every package of the run
a result with no review carries no such clause
tests.pseudocode: table in specgen/pipeline_test.go, replacing the reviewClause cases around the existing summary table: assert tc.r.Summary() == tc.want for each case

tests.title: Nothing checks alignment without a steering body or without the review
given: a pipeline run over a scripted model, against a spec root whose steering in turn says something, is missing, and holds only the bare heading

without the review no round runs at all and the result carries no review
with the review and a steering that says something, the prompts carry the directives and the instruction to check against them
